title: Agent Run Log
description: Observability record for one agent invocation. Constitution: a complex agent team that is not observable is not controllable. One line per agent run.

model.description: Historical logical workload alias after model_policy was applied; it is not a vendor model request. Null means no reasoning seat was dispatched.

runtime_model.description: Optional deployment-request binding copied from environment. It is not a provider-observed resolved model and must not be presented as one.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional deployment-request binding copied from environment. It is not provider-response evidence.

service_tier.description: Optional deployment-request binding copied from environment. It is not provider-response evidence.

runtime_observation_status.description: Current operate boundary cannot claim provider-attested runtime facts. Legacy rows may omit this field; new rows must explicitly state whether a model call was outside observability.

runtime_binding_source.description: Where optional runtime request bindings came from; never a provider usage source.

runtime_observation_reason.description: Why provider-level invocation metadata is unavailable or not applicable.

cost_tokens.description: Legacy aggregate field. Null or a caller-supplied value is not a provider-attested input/output token receipt.
